name: @checkly-templates/deploy
description: Entry point for `npx checkly` against this template repo. Loads the consumer's unified config, validates it, and registers one Checkly construct per entry via each kind's factory.
//workspaceDeps: The `@checkly-templates/*` workspace packages are intentionally not listed here. They are resolved locally via npm-workspace hoisting at the repo root. Listing them here would cause Checkly's cloud runner to attempt `npm install @checkly-templates/...` from the public registry and 404, since these packages are not published.
